worldConcept.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original game-art exploration contact sheet for a modern pixel-art Ukrainian defense themed Xonix arcade game. This is a visual reference sheet, not a technical diagram and not a production sprite atlas. Exactly 12 distinct charming, detailed but readable unit concepts arranged neatly as 4 columns by 3 rows, generous empty space separating each. Consistent elevated three-quarter top-down view, north/up facing vehicles, deliberate large squared 16-bit color clusters and stepped edges, beautiful restrained navy, warm ivory, olive and muted amber palette with tiny blue/yellow accents. Uniform dark navy background; no text, logos, numbers, captions or Z symbols. Row1: generic original tracked tank, wheeled armored personnel vehicle, cargo truck, medical support vehicle with a clear small medical bag symbol (not a real-world emblem). Row2: radar truck with a simple dish, communications/electronic support truck with upright mast, generic self-propelled artillery vehicle, generic box-launcher rocket-support truck with all compartments closed. Row3: helmeted engineer carrying a toolbox, helmeted medic carrying a medical bag, small tracked supply robot with cargo box, sleek uncrewed supply boat. No firing, explosions, blood, injured people, targets, action scenes, operating instructions, cutaways or weapon details. All designs are fictional original silhouettes, not exact named equipment models. Prioritize visual identity across many gameplay roles and distinct vehicle/character proportions. Crisp pixel art, no gradients, no cinematic blur, no photorealism.
